appDescription: A driving safety assistant that watches weather, road hazards, warning lights and driver fatigue, and speaks short warnings.

function.name: WAKE_ME_UP
function.description: Start the wake-up routine when the driver says they feel sleepy or tired: outside air, stronger fan, cooler temperature and seat ventilation, then offer the next drowsiness rest area as a waypoint.

function.name: REPORT_HAZARD
function.description: Report a road hazard the driver sees just ahead, such as debris, an accident, ice, a pothole or a stopped vehicle, so that cars coming behind are warned.

hazardType.description: The kind of hazard the driver reported.

function.name: SAFETY_BRIEFING
function.description: Read out a short safety briefing for the current drive: road condition and recommended speed, active warning lights, driving time and hazards nearby.
